records.prompt:
PROPORTION HARMONIZATION ONLY for the blue male GUARD in IMAGE1. Images2 and 3 are existing party characters and give the target real-head/body relationship. Keep his male identity, mature face and strong build. Do not copy women's anatomy, hairstyles, outfits or weapons.

Correct the HUMAN head/body ratio, NOT the giant ghost mask. The human head is behind/right of the shield.
Target roughly FOUR REAL HEAD HEIGHTS from anatomical skull crown to foot soles, excluding hair knot, beard extension, ghost-flame collar and entire shield. Count crown to anatomical chin as the head unit, not the beard tip. His real human face needs a little more presence beside the large shield.
Enlarge the real skull/face approximately 15–20 percent relative to the armored body. Shorten the neck and below-neck torso/leg lengths moderately about 8–10 percent if needed, evenly and anatomically. Keep broad shoulders/chest, substantial arms/boots and strong adult male proportions. Do not turn into a toddler, shrink head, make fat or squeeze the image. Preserve the clean simple facial shapes, full DARK beard with no white patch, hair/topknot, expression and current head direction.

LOCK SHIELD AND GEAR:
Preserve the user-selected HUGE ghost-face shield at its current overall visual size and detailed silhouette: cobalt/navy face, cyan eyes, upper and lower silver volumetric horns, slanted structure, silver borders, same perspective and orientation. Do not shrink the shield with the body, do not redesign it, do not return to smaller shield. Refit only the concealed supporting arm if necessary. Keep full dark navy heavy armor, shoulder, chest, skirt panels, knee/shin plates, closed empty right gauntlet and subdued clothing contrast. Do not substitute the rejected light-cloth outfit or expose forearm. No weapons.
Keep grounded stance and two visible planted boots, natural joints. Preserve rendering, colors, cloak/ghost collar and silhouette hierarchy. Face remains clear and not hidden by shield or collar; move one adjacent collar tuft slightly outward only if needed for the enlarged head.

Same project clean gem-icon style, bold outlines, coherent large matte value blocks, no added facets/noise. Full single guard on square warm ivory plain background, generous edge margin, all shield tips and boots visible. This should match the reference cast's compact real-head/body relationship while staying strong and mature. No text or comparison panels.

records.label: 阵师
records.prompt:
PROPORTION HARMONIZATION ONLY for the user-approved teal-haired SCROLL FORMATION MAGE in IMAGE1, to match the compact cast in IMAGES2/3.
The approved woman's actual head is too small relative to her long body/legs. Redraw anatomically to approximately FOUR real HEAD HEIGHTS from skull crown to soles, excluding her feather ornament and the entire scroll. Head unit is crown to chin. Increase her actual skull/face by about 20–25 percent relative to body and shorten below-neck length by about 12–15 percent, distributing shortening between torso and thigh/shin segments. Keep her elegant clearly ADULT identity, natural curves and slender graceful limbs, no bulky physique or baby face. Do not simply squeeze/stretch image or uniformly zoom.

DESIGN MUST STAY LOCKED to image1:
Exact teal bob, ivory forelock, flower pin and black/teal feather ornament; preserve selected slightly lowered THREE-QUARTER LEFT face, calm smile and green eyes. Do not replace her face with the reference women or alter hairstyle. Feather ornament must not grow along with the head.
Same rounded black CLOUD SHOULDER with ivory scalloped edge, small gold fastening, ivory chest facing, black shaped sash with OVAL JADE CLASP, ivory-lined rounded sleeves, curved long black wrap skirt with ivory underlap, rounded teal trailing cloth with large cloud motif and the original boots. Keep original outfit cut/coverage/palette, no new motifs/accessories.
Same one hand softly near chin, other hand holding the large calligraphy brush toward screen-right, same relaxed standing pose. Refit hands/elbows naturally to shorter limbs; brush shaft and gripping hand continuous. Shorten the dress and trailing cloth in relation to the body only enough to fit the new anatomy, not by changing the coverage or style. Both feet separate/grounded.
Same GIANT INK LANDSCAPE SCROLL behind her with two rollers, same broad arc and folded turn; keep large prop size so it remains distinctive. Left scroll paper remains ONE continuous ivory painted surface with NO internal black seam dividing it. Do not reintroduce that removed black line. Preserve simple ink mountains/birds and correct front/back paper geometry. Entire scroll and brush safely in frame.
No change to artistic finish: project clean icon outlines and large matte shaded color planes, no noisy facets, fine texture, glossy 3D render or new details.

Images2/3 give actual head/body scale only; do not copy their clothes, weapons, hair or faces. Output one complete approved scroll character with visibly larger actual head and more compact torso/legs, same adult elegant character and selected design, square plain warm ivory background, no text or comparison panels.
